text: This report provides the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") with information on the budgeted earned investment income required by the City of Toronto's Long Term Fund. This earned investment income is used to fund the City's Operating Budget as well as allocations to the Reserve Funds. As a follow-up to the Staff report provided to the Board in April 2018, this report is to inform the Board of the updated amount required and the timing with regard to cash outflows to the Short Term Fund.
The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Received the report (August 21, 2018) from the Acting Executive Director, Corporate Finance for information.
